                    ### Question
                    Which of the following drugs obtained by means of molecular engineering techniques is not applicable in the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis ?:

                    ### Options
                    opa. Infliximab.
opb. Denosumab.
opc. Adalimumab.
opd. Anakinra
ope. Etanercept.

### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
Infliximab, Adalimumab, and Etanercept are TNF-alpha inhibitors that reduce inflammation and are commonly used in the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis. Anakinra is an IL-1 receptor antagonist that also reduces inflammation and is used in rheumatoid arthritis. Denosumab, however, is a RANKL inhibitor primarily used to reduce bone resorption in conditions like osteoporosis and is not typically used for rheumatoid arthritis. Therefore, Denosumab is the drug not applicable in the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis.
